o1: Predicted to enable phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase binding activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in determination of adult lifespan; nematode male tail tip morphogenesis; positive regulation of early endosome to late endosome transport; innate immune response; autophagy; and defense response to bacterium. Is located in cytoplasmic vesicle and nucleus. Is expressed in intestine; nervous system; pharyngeal-intestinal valve; pharynx; and vulva. Predicted to be part of the autophagy pathway. Used to study Serratia marcescens infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Machado-Joseph disease and breast cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including BECN1 (beclin 1).
